modalLead: A fresh default look for new installs, updated starter bookmarks, a couple of small dashboard polish fixes, and the technical follow-through behind them.

items.text: New default theme — fresh installs now start on Kelp Drift (dark) with auto dark mode switched on, so the dashboard follows your system light/dark preference out of the box. Existing dashboards keep whatever theme you already chose.

Updated starter bookmarks — a brand-new install now seeds a Tech category with Unraid and Phoronix, and a Social category with Bluesky, in place of the old Facebook and Instagram entries. Your existing bookmarks are untouched.
Refreshed quick-add line — the & quick-add omnibox now uses the same rounded, blurred-glass styling and spring animation as the search, commands, and finders overlays instead of the old flat box.
Bookmarks config opens on the first page — Config → Bookmarks now always starts on your first page when you open config, and remembers the page you switch to for the rest of that session.

Icons with unusual filenames load reliably — bookmark and category icons whose filename contains a space or special character now display correctly on the dashboard instead of falling back to the letter badge.

Icon URLs are now encoded — the dashboard bookmark-row and category-header renderers wrap the icon filename in encodeURIComponent when building the /data/icons/… src, matching the inline editor, so filenames with a space, # or ? no longer break the request (dashboard-bookmark-rows.js, dashboard-render-core.js). The search overlay was already safe via its filename regex guard.

Translations back on par — dropped the orphan helpPageTipsTitle (de, fr) and helpPageExtensionTitle / helpPageSecurityTitle (fr) keys that had no code reference and were missing from en/nl, so all four locale files carry an identical key set again.
